item.text:
### (a) Three social posts

1. We believe that if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, everyone on Earth will die. We cannot accept that outcome. We must stop its development before it is too late.

2. We will not trade humanity’s future for superintelligent AI. If it is built within the next 20 years, everyone on Earth will die. We demand a halt to its development—not promises to make it safer.

3. We want a future in which humanity survives. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, everyone on Earth will die. We must act now to prevent its creation. Nothing matters more than keeping that future possible.

### (b) Newsletter opening

We face a stark choice: stop the development of superintelligent AI or lose everyone we love. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, everyone on Earth will die. We reject the idea that this is an acceptable price for technological progress. We refuse to let a race for power and profit decide whether humanity has a future. We demand a halt to the development of superintelligent AI, and we are organising to make that demand impossible to ignore. We have a responsibility to one another and to every generation still to come. We must act now to keep humanity alive.
